title: Package out for delivery
description: Tell recipients their parcel is out for delivery with a delivery window and tracking link. Utility WhatsApp template for carriers.
notes: A time window is more useful than a date. Keep marketing out of it to stay in utility.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your package *{{tracking}}* is out for delivery today. Estimated arrival: {{window}}. Please make sure someone can receive it.
